name: How can I get rid of a bad smell coming from my bathroom drain?

mainEntity.name: How can I get rid of a bad smell coming from my bathroom drain?

acceptedAnswer.text: To get rid of a bad smell from a bathroom drain, start by removing any visible hair or debris from the drain opening. Pour hot water down the drain, followed by a mixture of baking soda and vinegar, and let it sit for 30 minutes before flushing with more hot water. Ensure the P-trap beneath the sink has water in it by running the faucet periodically. If these steps don't work, a professional may need to clear a deeper clog or inspect for a dry P-trap or other issues.
acceptedAnswer.description: Remove debris, use baking soda and vinegar, or ensure the P-trap is full of water. If the smell persists, professional help may be needed.
